name: Magic links
description: Create and revoke single-use magic links for auth or plugin workflows.

capabilities.name: Create magic link
capabilities.description: Issue a single-use magic link. Maps to kernel command magic_link::create. Plugins may only use purposes under their own name.

capabilities.name: Revoke magic link
capabilities.description: Soft-revoke a magic link (sets revoked_at). Maps to kernel command magic_link::revoke.

capabilities.name: Inspect magic link
capabilities.description: Read metadata for a magic link without consuming it. Maps to kernel command magic_link::inspect.
